answer.reason: The verses tell of the gospel being spoken at Philippi, where Lydia's heart was opened, and of Paul's companions being shamefully treated there.

clauses.english: was where the Lord opened Lydia's heart to Paul's preaching by the river
was where Paul and his companions suffered and were shamefully treated
clauses.quote: we had suffered before, and were shamefully entreated

doubts: The notes at the end of 1CO 16:24 and 2CO 13:14 saying the epistles were written from Philippi are later subscriptions, not part of the letters, so I did not use them.
PHP 1:1 only addresses the letter to the saints there, so I left it out.
